## Summary

Describe the focused change and why it is needed.

## Validation

List the automated checks, manual tests, measurements, or generated artifacts
used to validate the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes relevant tests.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where behavior or workflows changed.
- [ ] I ran the relevant package recipe and `just precommit`.
- [ ] Hardware claims distinguish automated validation from physical evidence.
